title: Cities of Refuge

questions.question: What was the purpose of the cities of refuge?
options: That the manslayer who strikes any person without intent may flee there
For the king to live in
questions.correctAnswer: That the manslayer who strikes any person without intent may flee there
questions.explanation: Joshua 20:3 (ESV): "that the manslayer who strikes any person without intent or unknowingly may flee there..."

questions.question: Who are the cities a refuge from?
questions.explanation: Joshua 20:3 (ESV): "...they shall be for you a refuge from the avenger of blood."

questions.question: How many cities of refuge were appointed?
questions.explanation: Joshua 20:7-8 lists six cities (Kedesh, Shechem, Kiriath-arba, Bezer, Ramoth, Golan).

questions.question: What must the fugitive do upon arriving at the city gate?
options: Explain his case to the elders of that city
questions.correctAnswer: Explain his case to the elders of that city
questions.explanation: Joshua 20:4 (ESV): "...and explain his case to the elders of that city..."

questions.question: How long must the manslayer dwell in the city?
options: Until he stands before the congregation for judgment, and until the death of the high priest
questions.correctAnswer: Until he stands before the congregation for judgment, and until the death of the high priest
questions.explanation: Joshua 20:6 (ESV): "And he shall dwell in that city until he stands before the congregation for judgment, until the death of the one who is high priest..."

questions.question: Which city was appointed in Galilee?
questions.explanation: Joshua 20:7 (ESV): "So they set apart Kedesh in Galilee..."

questions.question: Which city was appointed in the hill country of Ephraim?
questions.explanation: Joshua 20:7 (ESV): "...and Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim..."

questions.question: Which city was appointed in the hill country of Judah?
questions.explanation: Joshua 20:7 (ESV): "...and Kiriath-arba (that is, Hebron) in the hill country of Judah."

questions.question: Which city was appointed from the tribe of Reuben (east)?
questions.explanation: Joshua 20:8 (ESV): "...Bezer in the wilderness on the tableland, from the tribe of Reuben..."

questions.question: If the avenger pursues him, should the elders deliver the manslayer into his hand?
options: No, because he struck his neighbor unknowingly
questions.correctAnswer: No, because he struck his neighbor unknowingly
questions.explanation: Joshua 20:5 (ESV): "And if the avenger of blood pursues him, they shall not give up the manslayer into his hand, because he struck his neighbor unknowingly..."

questions.question: Who commanded Joshua to assign the cities of refuge?
questions.explanation: Joshua 20:1 (ESV): "Then the Lord said to Joshua..."

questions.question: Which city was assigned from the tribe of Gad?
questions.explanation: Joshua 20:8 (ESV): "...and Ramoth in Gilead from the tribe of Gad..."

questions.question: Which city was assigned from the tribe of Manasseh (east)?
questions.explanation: Joshua 20:8 (ESV): "...and Golan in Bashan from the tribe of Manasseh."

questions.question: What term is used for the "avenger of blood"?
questions.explanation: The Hebrew term for Avenger of Blood is Goel HaDam.

questions.question: Can a deliberate murderer use these cities?
options: No, they must be put to death
Yes, if no one saw it
questions.correctAnswer: No, they must be put to death
questions.explanation: Implied in the "unintentional" condition. Other scriptures (Numbers 35) clarify deliberate murderers die.

key_verse_text: These were the cities designated for all the people of Israel and for the stranger sojourning among them, that anyone who killed a person without intent could flee there... (ESV)
